  reckon canonical_ui_size(mode : Text, value : Text) -> Text =
    "[" + json_quote(mode) + "," + choose(mode == "fixed", value, "null") + "]"

  reckon canonical_ui_layout(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + "," + canonical_ui_size(sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2))
      + "," + canonical_ui_size(sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4)) + "," + text(sequence_get(node, 5))
      + "," + text(sequence_get(node, 6)) + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 7)) + ","
      + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 8)) + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 9)) + "," + text(sequence_get(node, 10)) + "]"

  reckon find_ui_property(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), empty_sequence(),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == name, sequence_get(items, index),
        find_ui_property(items, index + 1, name)))

  reckon ui_style_property(name : Text) -> Truth =
    name == "foreground" or name == "background" or name == "font_family" or name == "font_size"
      or name == "text_align" or name == "corner_radius" or name == "language"

  reckon ui_inherited_property(name : Text) -> Truth =
    name == "foreground" or name == "font_family" or name == "font_size" or name == "text_align" or name == "language"

  reckon ui_style_specificity(kind : Text) -> Number = choose(kind == "role", 1, choose(kind == "class", 10, 100))

  reckon ui_style_matches(style : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(sequence_get(style, 1) == "role", sequence_get(style, 2) == sequence_get(node, 1),
      choose(sequence_get(style, 1) == "class", find_text(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, sequence_get(style, 2)) >= 0,
        sequence_get(style, 2) == sequence_get(node, 0)))

  reckon make_resolved_property(found : Truth, value : Text, provenance : Text, score : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), found), value), provenance), score)

  reckon resolve_ui_rules(styles : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, property : Text, best : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(styles), best,
      resolve_ui_rules(styles, index + 1, node, property,
        choose(ui_style_matches(sequence_get(styles, index), node)
            and length(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 4), 0, property)) > 0
            and (sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 3) * 10000
              + ui_style_specificity(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 1)) * 100
              + sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 5)) >= sequence_get(best, 3),
          make_resolved_property(true,
            ui_literal_json(sequence_get(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 4), 0, property), 1)),
            "rule:" + sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 0),
            sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 3) * 10000
              + ui_style_specificity(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 1)) * 100
              + sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 5)), best)))

  reckon resolve_ui_property_after_rule(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, property : Text, rule : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(rule, 0), rule,
      choose(length(themes) > 0 and length(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 1), 0, property)) > 0,
        make_resolved_property(true,
          ui_literal_json(sequence_get(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 1), 0, property), 1)),
          "theme:" + sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 0), 0),
        make_resolved_property(false, "", "", -1)))

  reckon resolve_ui_property(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, property : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(find_ui_property(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, property)) > 0 and ui_style_property(property),
      make_resolved_property(true,
        ui_literal_json(sequence_get(find_ui_property(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, property), 1)),
        "node:" + sequence_get(node, 0), 1000000000),
      resolve_ui_property_after_rule(node, themes, property,
        resolve_ui_rules(styles, 0, node, property, make_resolved_property(false, "", "", -1))))

  reckon ui_style_property_names() -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "background"), "corner_radius"), "font_family"), "font_size"), "foreground"), "language"), "text_align")

  reckon canonical_resolved_object(names : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, provenance : Truth, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(names), output + "}",
      canonical_resolved_object(names, index + 1, node, themes, styles, provenance,
        choose(sequence_get(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)), 0),
          output + choose(output == "{", "", ",") + json_quote(sequence_get(names, index)) + ":"
            + choose(provenance,
              json_quote(sequence_get(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)), 2)),
              sequence_get(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)), 1)), output)))

  reckon canonical_ui_resolved_style(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + canonical_resolved_object(ui_style_property_names(), 0, node, themes, styles, false, "{")

      + canonical_ui_events(sequence_get(node, 5), 0, sequence_get(node, 0), states, derived, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_layout(ui_view_layout(node)) + "," + canonical_ui_adaptive_layouts(ui_view_adaptive_layouts(node), 0, "[")
      + "," + canonical_ui_resolved_style(node, themes, styles) + ","

  reckon canonical_ui_themes(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon cui(node : Sequence, reality : Text) -> Text =
    "[\"rcl.native-ui.semantic-genome.v0.1\",\"rcl.native-ui.program.v0.1\",\"0.1.0\",\"UIProgram\"," + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0))

      + canonical_ui_node(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 8), 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)) + ","
      + canonical_ui_style_sheet(sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)) + ",["
      + canonical_ui_texts(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, "[") + "," + canonical_ui_texts(sequence_get(node, 4), 0, "[")
      + "],[" + choose(length(ui_navigation(node)) == 0, "null",

          + json_quote(sequence_get(ui_navigation(node), 0)) + ",\"routes\":"

  reckon canonical_expression(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "LiteralExpr",
      "{\"kind\":\"LiteralExpr\",\"value\":"
        + choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Text", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)),
            choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Truth", json_truth(sequence_get(node, 2)), sequence_get(node, 2)))
        + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "PathExpr",
        "{\"kind\":\"PathExpr\",\"path\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
        choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "UnaryExpr",
          "{\"expression\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 2)) + ",\"kind\":\"UnaryExpr\",\"operator\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
          choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "BinaryExpr",
            "{\"kind\":\"BinaryExpr\",\"left\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 2))
              + ",\"operator\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + ",\"right\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 3)) + "}",
            "{\"args\":" + canonical_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, "[")
              + ",\"kind\":\"CallExpr\",\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}"))))

          + "{\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0))
          + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + "}"))

      + ",\"line\":" + text(sequence_get(node, 4)) + "},\"owner\":"
      + choose(sequence_get(node, 3) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 3)))
      + ",\"path\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + ",\"value\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 2))
      + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}"

      canonical_facets(items, index + 1,

      + ",\"returnType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)) + "}"

      + ",\"target\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)) + "}"

  reckon canonical_warrants(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

      + ",\"from\":" + choose(sequence_get(node, 3) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 3)))
      + ",\"into\":" + choose(sequence_get(node, 4) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 4)))
      + ",\"kind\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + ",\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1))

      + ",\"preserves\":" + canonical_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 7), 0, "[")

      + ",\"witnesses\":" + canonical_text_array(sequence_get(node, 9), 0, "[") + "}"

  reckon canonical_dialect_operations(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon predicate_unary_type(operator : Text, actual : Text) -> Text =
    choose(operator == not_operator(),
      choose(semantic_check(predicate_accepts("Truth", actual), "RCL_TYPE_UNARY", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
      predicate_checked_type(actual, "Number", "RCL_TYPE_UNARY", operator))

  reckon predicate_binary_type(operator : Text, left : Text, right : Text) -> Text =
    choose(operator == "and" or operator == "or",
      choose(semantic_check(predicate_accepts("Truth", left) and predicate_accepts("Truth", right), "RCL_TYPE_LOGIC", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
      choose(left == "Unknown" or right == "Unknown",
        choose(operator == "==" or operator == "!=" or operator == "<" or operator == "<=" or operator == ">" or operator == ">=", "Truth", "Unknown"),
        choose(operator == "==" or operator == "!=",
          choose(semantic_check(left == right, "RCL_TYPE_BINARY", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
          choose(operator == "<" or operator == "<=" or operator == ">" or operator == ">=",
            choose(semantic_check(left == "Number" and right == "Number", "RCL_TYPE_BINARY", operator), "Truth", "Unknown"),
            choose(operator == "+" and left == "Text" and right == "Text", "Text",
              choose(semantic_check(left == "Number" and right == "Number", "RCL_TYPE_BINARY", operator), "Number", "Unknown"))))))

            predicate_call_type(sequence_get(node, 1), predicate_argument_types(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, locals, facets, reckons, visited, empty_sequence()), facets, reckons, visited)))))

          indexed_count_binary(indexed_expression_count_cached(sequence_get(node, 2)), indexed_expression_count_cached(sequence_get(node, 3)),
            choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "and" or sequence_get(node, 1) == "or", 5, 1)), indexed_call_count(node))))
  reckon indexed_counted_node(node : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_append(node, indexed_count_safe(node))


  reckon provider_literal_arguments(node : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(length(sequence_get(node, 2)) != 3, false,
      sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 0), 0) == "LiteralExpr"
        and sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 0), 1) == "Text"
        and sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 1), 0) == "LiteralExpr"
        and sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 1), 1) == "Text"
        and sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 2), 0) == "LiteralExpr"
        and sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 2), 1) == "Text")

  reckon facet_instruction_count(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Number) -> Number =

  reckon alter_instruction_count(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Number) -> Number =

      + alter_instruction_count(sequence_get(node, 8), 0, 0)
      + choose(length(sequence_get(node, 7)) > 0,

  reckon make_instruction(op : Number, a : Number, b : Number, c : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), op), a), b), c)

  reckon make_flagged_instruction(op : Number, a : Number, b : Number, c : Number, flags : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon indexed_pair(left : Sequence, right : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), left), right)
  reckon indexed_empty_buckets(n : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(n <= 1, empty_sequence(), indexed_pair(indexed_empty_buckets(n / 2, output), indexed_empty_buckets(n / 2, output)))
  reckon indexed_bucket_at(items : Sequence, position : Number, span : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(span <= 1, items,
      choose(position < span / 2, indexed_bucket_at(sequence_get(items, 0), position, span / 2),
        indexed_bucket_at(sequence_get(items, 1), position - span / 2, span / 2)))
  reckon indexed_bucket_set(items : Sequence, position : Number, value : Sequence, span : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(span <= 1, value,
      choose(position < span / 2,
        indexed_pair(indexed_bucket_set(sequence_get(items, 0), position, value, span / 2), sequence_get(items, 1)),
        indexed_pair(sequence_get(items, 0), indexed_bucket_set(sequence_get(items, 1), position - span / 2, value, span / 2))))

  reckon indexed_bucket_replace(items : Sequence, position : Number, value : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_bucket_set(items, position, value, 64)

  reckon indexed_insert(items : Sequence, index : Number, buckets : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), buckets,
      indexed_insert(items, index + 1,
        indexed_bucket_replace(buckets, length(sequence_get(items, index)) % 64,
          sequence_append(indexed_bucket_at(buckets, length(sequence_get(items, index)) % 64, 64),
            sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), sequence_get(items, index)), index)),
          0, empty_sequence())))
  reckon indexed_bucket_find(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == value,
        sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1), indexed_bucket_find(items, index + 1, value)))
  reckon indexed_pool_find(value : Text) -> Number =
    indexed_bucket_find(indexed_bucket_at(compiler.string_index, length(value) % 64, 64), 0, value)
  reckon indexed_function_insert(items : Sequence, index : Number, address : Number, buckets : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), buckets,
      indexed_function_insert(items, index + 1, address + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 4) + 1,
        indexed_bucket_replace(buckets, length(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) % 64,
          sequence_append(indexed_bucket_at(buckets, length(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) % 64, 64),
            sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)), address)),

  reckon indexed_function_find(name : Text) -> Number =
    indexed_bucket_find(indexed_bucket_at(compiler.function_index, length(name) % 64, 64), 0, name)
  reckon indexed_names_insert(items : Sequence, index : Number, buckets : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), buckets,
      indexed_names_insert(items, index + 1,

  reckon indexed_validation_find(name : Text) -> Number =

  reckon indexed_text_state(items : Sequence, buckets : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), items), buckets)
  reckon indexed_unique_text_add(state : Sequence, value : Text, bucket : Number) -> Sequence =
    indexed_text_state(sequence_append(sequence_get(state, 0), value),
      indexed_bucket_replace(sequence_get(state, 1), bucket,
        sequence_append(indexed_bucket_at(sequence_get(state, 1), bucket, 64),
          sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), value), length(sequence_get(state, 0)))), 0, empty_sequence()))
  reckon indexed_unique_text(state : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(indexed_bucket_find(indexed_bucket_at(sequence_get(state, 1), length(value) % 64, 64), 0, value) >= 0, state,
      indexed_unique_text_add(state, value, length(value) % 64))

  reckon indexed_collect_expression_strings(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "LiteralExpr",

      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "PathExpr",
        choose(find_text(locals, 0, sequence_get(node, 1)) >= 0, output, indexed_unique_text(output, sequence_get(node, 1))),
        choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "UnaryExpr",
          indexed_collect_expression_strings(sequence_get(node, 2), locals, output),
          choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "BinaryExpr",
            indexed_collect_expression_strings(sequence_get(node, 3), locals,

  reckon indexed_build_string_pool(program : Sequence, root : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_get(indexed_collect_reckon_strings(sequence_get(program, 2), 0,
      choose(has_conditional_warrants(sequence_get(program, 4), 0),
        indexed_collect_dynamic_directive_strings(sequence_get(program, 6), 0, sequence_get(program, 5), sequence_get(program, 2), sequence_get(program, 4),
          indexed_collect_facet_strings(sequence_get(program, 1), 0, indexed_unique_text(indexed_unique_text(indexed_text_state(empty_sequence(), indexed_empty_buckets(64, empty_sequence())), sequence_get(program, 0)), root))),
        indexed_collect_directive_strings(sequence_get(program, 6), 0, sequence_get(program, 5), sequence_get(program, 2),
          indexed_collect_warrant_strings(sequence_get(program, 4), 0,
            indexed_collect_facet_strings(sequence_get(program, 1), 0, indexed_unique_text(indexed_unique_text(indexed_text_state(empty_sequence(), indexed_empty_buckets(64, empty_sequence())), sequence_get(program, 0)), root)))))), 0)

  reckon one_instruction(op : Number, a : Number, b : Number, c : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(empty_sequence(), make_instruction(op, a, b, c))

  reckon one_flagged_instruction(op : Number, a : Number, b : Number, c : Number, flags : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon binary_opcode(operator : Text) -> Number =
    choose(operator == "+", 6,
      choose(operator == minus_operator(), 7,
        choose(operator == "*", 8,
          choose(operator == "/", 9,
            choose(operator == "==", 10,
              choose(operator == "!=", 11,
                choose(operator == "<", 12,
                  choose(operator == "<=", 13,
                    choose(operator == ">", 14,
                      choose(operator == ">=", 15, 44))))))))))

  reckon emit_expression_array(items : Sequence, index : Number, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon emit_short_binary(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "and",
      append_all(one_instruction(2, 0, 0, 0),
        append_all(one_instruction(20, start + expression_count(node), 0, 0),
          append_all(one_instruction(18, 0, 0, 0),
            append_all(one_instruction(18, 0, 0, 0),
              append_all(emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 3), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count,
                  start + expression_count(sequence_get(node, 2)) + 1),
                append_all(one_instruction(21, start + expression_count(node) - 1, 0, 0),
                  emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 2), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start))))))),
      append_all(one_instruction(18, 0, 0, 0),
        append_all(one_instruction(18, 0, 0, 0),
          append_all(emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 3), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count,
              start + expression_count(sequence_get(node, 2)) + 3),
            append_all(one_instruction(20, start + expression_count(node), 0, 0),

                append_all(one_instruction(21, start + expression_count(sequence_get(node, 2)) + 3, 0, 0),
                  emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 2), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start))))))))

  reckon emit_binary(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "and" or sequence_get(node, 1) == "or",
      emit_short_binary(node, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start),

        append_all(emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 3), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count,

  reckon emit_choose(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon emit_call(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "provider_call",
      choose(provider_literal_arguments(node),
        one_instruction(35,
          indexed_pool_find( sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 0), 2)),
          indexed_pool_find( sequence_get(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 1), 2)),

        append_all(one_flagged_instruction(35, 0, 0, 0, 1),
          emit_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start, empty_sequence()))),
      choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "choose", emit_choose(node, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start),
        indexed_emit_call_builtin(node, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start, builtin_id(sequence_get(node, 1)))))

  reckon indexed_emit_call_builtin(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number, builtin : Number) -> Sequence =
    append_all(one_instruction(
            choose(builtin > 0, 30, 33),
            choose(builtin > 0, builtin,
              main_count + indexed_function_find(sequence_get(node, 1))),
            length(sequence_get(node, 2)), 0),
          emit_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start, empty_sequence()))

  reckon emit_expression(node : Sequence, locals : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "LiteralExpr",
      choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Number", one_instruction(1, find_number(numbers, 0, number_from_text(sequence_get(node, 2))), 0, 0),
        choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Truth", one_instruction(2, choose(sequence_get(node, 2) == "true", 1, 0), 0, 0),
          one_instruction(3, indexed_pool_find( sequence_get(node, 2)), 0, 0))),
      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "PathExpr",
        indexed_emit_path_index(sequence_get(node, 1), find_text(locals, 0, sequence_get(node, 1))),
        choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "UnaryExpr",
          append_all(one_instruction(choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == not_operator(), 18, 19), 0, 0, 0),
            emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 2), locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start)),
          choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "BinaryExpr",
            emit_binary(node, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start),
            emit_call(node, locals, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start)))))

  reckon emit_rule_preserves(items : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(items) == 0, empty_sequence(),
      append_all(one_instruction(26, 0, 0, 0),
        emit_preserve_items(items, 0, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start,
          one_instruction(26, 1, 0, 0))))

  reckon emit_rule_witnesses(items : Sequence, index : Number, strings : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      emit_rule_witnesses(items, index + 1, strings,
        append_all(one_instruction(28, indexed_pool_find( sequence_get(items, index)), 0, 0), output)))

  reckon emit_rule_invocation(node : Sequence, mode : Number, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number) -> Sequence =
    append_all(one_instruction(29, 0, 0, 0),
      append_all(emit_rule_witnesses(sequence_get(node, 9), 0, strings, empty_sequence()),
        append_all(emit_rule_preserves(sequence_get(node, 7), reckons, strings, numbers, main_count,
            start + expression_count(sequence_get(node, 5)) + 2 + length(sequence_get(node, 6))
              + alter_instruction_count(sequence_get(node, 8), 0, 0)),
          append_all(emit_rule_alters(sequence_get(node, 8), 0, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count,
              start + expression_count(sequence_get(node, 5)) + 2 + length(sequence_get(node, 6)), empty_sequence()),
            append_all(emit_rule_needs(sequence_get(node, 6), 0, rule_actor(node), strings, empty_sequence()),
              append_all(one_flagged_instruction(23, mode,
                  indexed_pool_find( sequence_get(node, 1)), indexed_pool_find( rule_actor(node)),
                  choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "Resonance", 1, 0)),
                append_all(one_instruction(21, start + rule_instruction_count(node), 0, 0),
                  emit_expression(sequence_get(node, 5), empty_sequence(), reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start))))))))

  reckon emit_directives(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      emit_directives(items, index + 1, rules, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start,
        append_all(emit_rule_invocation(find_rule(rules, 0, sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == "Realize", 1, 0),
            reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start + length(output)), output)))

  reckon emit_dynamic_directives(items : Sequence, index : Number, rules : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      emit_dynamic_directives(items, index + 1, rules, reckons, warrants, strings, numbers, main_count,
        append_all(emit_rule_invocation(find_rule(rules, 0, sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == "Realize", 1, 0), reckons, strings, numbers, main_count,
            length(output) + dynamic_warrant_count(warrants, 0, 1)),
          append_all(emit_warrant_refresh(warrants, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, length(output)), output))))

  reckon emit_reckons(items : Sequence, index : Number, reckons : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, main_count : Number, start : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      emit_reckons(items, index + 1, reckons, strings, numbers, main_count, start,
        append_all(one_instruction(34, 0, 0, 0),
          append_all(emit_expression(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 3),
              param_names(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1), 0, empty_sequence()), reckons, strings, numbers,
              main_count, start + length(output)), output))))

  reckon build_instructions(program : Sequence, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    append_all(
      emit_reckons(sequence_get(program, 2), 0, sequence_get(program, 2), strings, numbers,
        main_instruction_count(program), main_instruction_count(program), empty_sequence()),
      append_all(one_instruction(31, 0, 0, 0),
        choose(has_conditional_warrants(sequence_get(program, 4), 0),
          emit_dynamic_directives(sequence_get(program, 6), 0, sequence_get(program, 5), sequence_get(program, 2), sequence_get(program, 4), strings, numbers, main_instruction_count(program),
            emit_facets(sequence_get(program, 1), 0, sequence_get(program, 2), strings, numbers, main_instruction_count(program), 0, empty_sequence())),
          emit_directives(sequence_get(program, 6), 0, sequence_get(program, 5), sequence_get(program, 2), strings, numbers, main_instruction_count(program), 0,
            emit_warrants(sequence_get(program, 4), 0, strings,
              emit_facets(sequence_get(program, 1), 0, sequence_get(program, 2), strings, numbers, main_instruction_count(program), 0, empty_sequence()))))))

  reckon encode_string_record(value : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(length(utf8_bytes(value))), utf8_bytes(value))

  reckon encode_string_pool(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      encode_string_pool(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, encode_string_record(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon encode_number_pool(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      encode_number_pool(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, bytes_f64le(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon encode_instruction(node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(bytes_u8(sequence_get(node, 0)),
      sequence_concat(bytes_u8(choose(length(node) > 4, sequence_get(node, 4), 0)),
        sequence_concat(bytes_u16le(0),
          sequence_concat(bytes_i32le(sequence_get(node, 1)),
            sequence_concat(bytes_i32le(sequence_get(node, 2)), bytes_i32le(sequence_get(node, 3)))))))

  reckon encode_instructions(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      encode_instructions(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, encode_instruction(sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon instruction_flags(node : Sequence) -> Number = choose(length(node) > 4, sequence_get(node, 4), 0)

  reckon instructions_require_v12(items : Sequence, index : Number) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == 44
          or (sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == 35 and instruction_flags(sequence_get(items, index)) == 1),
        true, instructions_require_v12(items, index + 1)))

  reckon instructions_require_v13(items : Sequence, index : Number) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) >= 45
          or (sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == 22 and instruction_flags(sequence_get(items, index)) == 1),
        true, instructions_require_v13(items, index + 1)))

  reckon encode_header(program_index : Number, root_index : Number, string_count : Number, number_count : Number, instruction_count : Number, minor : Number) -> Sequence =
    encode_header_with_flags(program_index, root_index, string_count, number_count, instruction_count, minor, 0)

  reckon encode_header_with_flags(program_index : Number, root_index : Number, string_count : Number, number_count : Number, instruction_count : Number, minor : Number, flags : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(utf8_bytes("RCLB"),
      sequence_concat(bytes_u16le(1),
        sequence_concat(bytes_u16le(minor),
          sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(flags),
            sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(program_index),
              sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(root_index),
                sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(string_count),
                  sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(number_count),
                    sequence_concat(bytes_u32le(instruction_count), bytes_u32le(0))))))))))

  reckon encode_rbc(program : Sequence, root : Text, strings : Sequence, numbers : Sequence, instructions : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_concat(
      encode_header(indexed_pool_find( sequence_get(program, 0)), indexed_pool_find( root),
        length(strings), length(numbers), length(instructions), choose(instructions_require_v13(instructions, 0), 3, choose(instructions_require_v12(instructions, 0), 2, 1))),
      sequence_concat(encode_string_pool(strings, 0, empty_sequence()),
        sequence_concat(encode_number_pool(numbers, 0, empty_sequence()),
          encode_instructions(instructions, 0, empty_sequence()))))

  reckon k337_scope_matches(granted : Text, required : Text) -> Truth =
    choose(granted == "*", true,
      choose(granted == required, true, starts_with(required, granted + ".")))

  reckon k337_warrant_matches(node : Sequence, actor : Text, need : Sequence) -> Truth =
    sequence_get(node, 0) == actor
      and sequence_get(node, 1) == sequence_get(need, 0)
      and k337_scope_matches(sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(need, 1))

  reckon k337_warrant_exists(items : Sequence, index : Number, actor : Text, need : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      choose(k337_warrant_matches(sequence_get(items, index), actor, need), true,
        k337_warrant_exists(items, index + 1, actor, need)))

  reckon k337_validate_rule_needs(items : Sequence, index : Number, warrants : Sequence, actor : Text, name : Text) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(actor == "", k337_validate_rule_needs(items, index + 1, warrants, actor, name),
        choose(semantic_check(k337_warrant_exists(warrants, 0, actor, sequence_get(items, index)),
            "RCL_WARRANT_MISSING", name + ":" + actor + ":" + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) + ":" + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)),
          k337_validate_rule_needs(items, index + 1, warrants, actor, name), false)))

  reckon k337_validate_rules(items : Sequence, index : Number, warrants : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), true,
      choose(k337_validate_rule_needs(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 6), 0, warrants,
          rule_actor(sequence_get(items, index)), sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)),
        k337_validate_rules(items, index + 1, warrants), false))

  reckon k337_validated_program(program : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(k337_validate_rules(sequence_get(program, 5), 0, sequence_get(program, 4)), program, program)

  facet compiler.source : Text = provider_call("compiler_input", "source", "{}")
  facet compiler.tokens : Sequence = tokenize(compiler.source)
  facet compiler.raw_program : Sequence = parse_program(compiler.tokens)
  facet compiler.validation_index : Sequence = indexed_names_insert(sequence_get(compiler.raw_program, 2), 0, indexed_empty_buckets(64, empty_sequence()))
  facet compiler.program : Sequence = k337_validated_program(validated_program(compiler.raw_program))
  facet compiler.function_index : Sequence = indexed_function_insert(sequence_get(compiler.program, 2), 0, 0, indexed_empty_buckets(64, empty_sequence()))
  facet compiler.canonical : Text = canonical_program(compiler.program)
  facet compiler.root : Text = sha256_text(compiler.canonical)
  facet compiler.strings : Sequence = indexed_build_string_pool(compiler.program, compiler.root)
  facet compiler.string_index : Sequence = indexed_insert(compiler.strings, 0, indexed_empty_buckets(64, empty_sequence()))
  facet compiler.numbers : Sequence = build_number_pool(compiler.program)
  facet compiler.instructions : Sequence = build_instructions(compiler.program, compiler.strings, compiler.numbers)
  facet compiler.output : Sequence = encode_rbc(compiler.program, compiler.root, compiler.strings, compiler.numbers, compiler.instructions)
}

reality RCLGeneralSelfHostCompiler {
  facet selfhost.splice_format : Text = "rcl-open-module-v1: concatenate compiler-core.rcl, newline, compiler-main.rcl"

  reckon make_token_node(kind : Text, value : Text, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), kind), value), line), column)

  reckon token_span_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Span =
    make_span(0, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 2), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 3), 0)

  reckon require_token(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expected : Text, code : Text) -> Truth =
    semantic_assert(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == expected, code, expected, token_span_at(tokens, index))

  reckon require_kind(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expected : Text, code : Text) -> Truth =
    semantic_assert(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == expected, code, expected, token_span_at(tokens, index))

  reckon syntax_failure(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, code : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(semantic_assert(false, code, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1), token_span_at(tokens, index)),
      make_node_state(index, empty_sequence()), make_node_state(index, empty_sequence()))

  reckon make_text_state(index : Number, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), value)

  reckon make_node_state(index : Number, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), value)

  reckon append_all(items : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_concat(output, items)

  reckon find_text(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(items, index) == value, index, find_text(items, index + 1, value)))

  reckon find_number(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(items, index) == value, index, find_number(items, index + 1, value)))

  reckon append_unique_number(items : Sequence, value : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(find_number(items, 0, value) >= 0, items, sequence_append(items, value))

  reckon either(left : Truth, right : Truth) -> Truth = choose(left, true, right)
  reckon both(left : Truth, right : Truth) -> Truth = choose(left, right, false)
  reckon minus_operator() -> Text = char_at("-x", 0)
  reckon not_operator() -> Text = slice_text("notx", 0, 3)

  reckon scan_identifier_end(source : Text, index : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(is_identifier_part(char_at(source, index)), scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1), index))

  reckon scan_number_end(source : Text, index : Number, seen_dot : Truth) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(is_digit(char_at(source, index)), scan_number_end(source, index + 1, seen_dot),
        choose(both(char_at(source, index) == char_at(".", 0), not seen_dot),
          scan_number_end(source, index + 1, true), index)))

  reckon scan_string_end(source : Text, index : Number, escaped : Truth) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(escaped, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false),
        choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\\", 0), scan_string_end(source, index + 1, true),
          choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\"", 0), index,
            scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false)))))

  reckon decoded_escape(value : Text) -> Text =
    choose(value == "n", "\n",
      choose(value == "r", "\r",
        choose(value == "t", "\t",
          choose(value == "\"", "\"", choose(value == "\\", "\\", value)))))

  reckon decode_string_from(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= end, output,
      choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\\", 0),
        decode_string_from(source, index + 2, end, output + decoded_escape(char_at(source, index + 1))),
        decode_string_from(source, index + 1, end, output + char_at(source, index))))

  reckon scan_comment_end(source : Text, index : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n", index, scan_comment_end(source, index + 1)))

  reckon position_after(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= end, sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), line), column),
      choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n",
        position_after(source, index + 1, end, line + 1, 1),
        position_after(source, index + 1, end, line, column + choose(length(utf8_bytes(char_at(source, index))) == 4, 2, 1))))

  reckon is_two_symbol(value : Text) -> Truth =
    value == "<-" or value == "->" or value == "==" or value == "!=" or value == "<=" or value == ">="

  reckon concat_token_chunks(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      concat_token_chunks(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon tokenize_emit(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence, token : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(chunk) >= 127,
      tokenize_from(source, index, line, column, sequence_append(chunks, chunk),
        sequence_append(empty_sequence(), token)),
      tokenize_from(source, index, line, column, chunks, sequence_append(chunk, token)))


  reckon indexed_identifier_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_emit(source, end, line, column + end - index, chunks, chunk,
      make_token_node("IDENT", slice_text(source, index, end - index), line, column))
  reckon indexed_number_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_emit(source, end, line, column + end - index, chunks, chunk,
      make_token_node("NUMBER", slice_text(source, index, end - index), line, column))
  reckon indexed_comment_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_from(source, end, line, column + end - index, chunks, chunk)
  reckon indexed_string_position_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, position : Sequence, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_emit(source, end + 1, sequence_get(position, 0), sequence_get(position, 1), chunks, chunk,
      make_token_node("STRING", decode_string_from(source, index + 1, end, ""), line, column))
  reckon indexed_string_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_string_position_emit(source, index, end, line, column, position_after(source, index, end + 1, line, column), chunks, chunk)

  reckon tokenize_from(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(source),
      concat_token_chunks(sequence_append(chunks, sequence_append(chunk, make_token_node("EOF", "<eof>", line, column))), 0, empty_sequence()),
      indexed_tokenize_character(source, index, line, column, chunks, chunk, char_at(source, index)))

  reckon indexed_tokenize_character(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence, character : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(is_whitespace(character),
        choose(character == "\n",
          tokenize_from(source, index + 1, line + 1, 1, chunks, chunk),
          tokenize_from(source, index + 1, line, column + 1, chunks, chunk)),
        choose(either(character == char_at("#", 0), slice_text(source, index, 2) == "//"),
          indexed_comment_emit(source, index, scan_comment_end(source, index), line, column, chunks, chunk),
          choose(is_identifier_start(character),
            indexed_identifier_emit(source, index, scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1), line, column, chunks, chunk),
            choose(is_digit(character),
              indexed_number_emit(source, index, scan_number_end(source, index + 1, false), line, column, chunks, chunk),
              choose(character == char_at("\"", 0),
                indexed_string_emit(source, index, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false), line, column, chunks, chunk),
                choose(is_two_symbol(slice_text(source, index, 2)),
                  tokenize_emit(source, index + 2, line, column + 2, chunks, chunk,
                    make_token_node("SYMBOL", slice_text(source, index, 2), line, column)),
                  tokenize_emit(source, index + 1, line, column + 1, chunks, chunk,
                    make_token_node("SYMBOL", character, line, column))))))))

  reckon tokenize(source : Text) -> Sequence = tokenize_from(source, 0, 1, 1, empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_path_tail(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == ".",
      parse_path_tail(tokens, index + 2, value + "." + sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)),
      make_text_state(index, value))

  reckon parse_path(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_path_tail(tokens, index + 1, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))

  reckon literal_node(value_type : Text, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "LiteralExpr"), value_type), value))

  reckon path_node(path : Text) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "PathExpr"), path))

  reckon unary_node(operator : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "UnaryExpr"), operator), expression))

  reckon binary_node(operator : Text, left : Sequence, right : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "BinaryExpr"), operator), left), right))

  reckon call_node(name : Text, args : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "CallExpr"), name), args))

  reckon binary_precedence(operator : Text) -> Number =
    choose(operator == "or", 1,
      choose(operator == "and", 2,
        choose(operator == "==" or operator == "!=", 3,
          choose(operator == "<" or operator == "<=" or operator == ">" or operator == ">=", 4,
            choose(operator == "+" or operator == minus_operator(), 5,
              choose(operator == "*" or operator == "/" or operator == "%", 6, 0))))))

  reckon parse_call_args(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == ")", make_node_state(index + 1, output),
      parse_call_args_after(tokens, parse_expression(tokens, index, 0), output))

  reckon parse_call_args_after(tokens : Sequence, item_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(item_state, 0)), 1) == ",",
      parse_call_args(tokens, sequence_get(item_state, 0) + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(item_state, 1))),
      make_node_state(sequence_get(item_state, 0) + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(item_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_prefix(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == not_operator(), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == minus_operator()),
      parse_unary_after(tokens, index, parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 7)),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == "NUMBER",
        make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Number", text(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))))),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == "STRING",
          make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Text", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))),
          choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "true", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "false"),
            make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Truth", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "(",
              parse_parenthesized_after(parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 0)),
              parse_identifier_expression(tokens, parse_path(tokens, index)))))))

  reckon parse_unary_after(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0), unary_node(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1), sequence_get(expression_state, 1)))

  reckon parse_parenthesized_after(expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0) + 1, sequence_get(expression_state, 1))

  reckon parse_identifier_expression(tokens : Sequence, path_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(path_state, 0)), 1) == "(",
      parse_identifier_call_after(sequence_get(path_state, 1), parse_call_args(tokens, sequence_get(path_state, 0) + 1, empty_sequence())),

  reckon parse_binary_tail(tokens : Sequence, left : Sequence, index : Number, minimum : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_dialect_after_lowers(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_dialect_body(tokens, sequence_get(list_state, 0),
      make_dialect(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4),
        sequence_get(node, 5), append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 6)), sequence_get(node, 7)))

  reckon parse_dialect_after_operation(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, operation_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_dialect_body(tokens, sequence_get(operation_state, 0),
      make_dialect(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4),
        sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(operation_state, 1)), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7)))

  reckon parse_dialect_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "version",
        parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2, dialect_with_version(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "layer",
          parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2, dialect_with_layer(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "domain",
            parse_dialect_after_domain(tokens, node, parse_path(tokens, index + 1)),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "description",
              parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2, dialect_with_description(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
              choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "lowers_to",
                parse_dialect_after_lowers(tokens, node, parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())),
                choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "operation",
                  parse_dialect_after_operation(tokens, node, parse_dialect_operation(tokens, index)),
                  parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2,
                    make_dialect(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4),
                      sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6),
                      sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)))))))))))

  reckon parse_dialect(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 3,
      make_dialect(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), "0.14.0-alpha.1", "semantic", "", "",
        empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence()))

  reckon make_capability(capability : Text, target : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon make_policy(name : Text, allowed : Sequence, denied : Sequence, capabilities : Sequence, host_capabilities : Sequence, budget : Sequence, require_replay : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), allowed), denied), capabilities), host_capabilities), budget), require_replay)

  reckon parse_policy_after_list(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, clause : Text, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_body(tokens, sequence_get(list_state, 0),
      choose(clause == "allow_effect",
        make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 1)), sequence_get(node, 2),
          sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)),
        choose(clause == "deny_effect",
          make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 2)),
            sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)),
          make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
            append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 4)), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)))))

  reckon parse_policy_after_target(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, capability : Text, target_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_body(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0),
      make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2),
        sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 3), make_capability(capability, sequence_get(target_state, 1))),
        sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)))

  reckon parse_policy_after_capability(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, capability_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_after_target(tokens, node, sequence_get(capability_state, 1), parse_path(tokens, sequence_get(capability_state, 0) + 1))

  reckon parse_policy_require(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "true", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "false"),
      parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 2,
        make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
          sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
      parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 1,
        make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
          sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), "true")))

  reckon parse_policy_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "allow_effect", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "deny_effect"),
        parse_policy_after_list(tokens, node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1),
          parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "allow",
          parse_policy_after_capability(tokens, node, parse_path(tokens, index + 1)),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "allow_host",
            parse_policy_after_list(tokens, node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1),
              parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "budget",
              parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 3,
                make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
                  sequence_get(node, 4),
                  sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 5), make_budget(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1),
                    text(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 2), 1))))), sequence_get(node, 6))),
              parse_policy_require(tokens, index, node))))))

  reckon parse_policy(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =

      make_policy(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), "false"))

      make_ui_property(name, sequence_get(expression_state, 1), allow_inherit and sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(expression_state, 0)), 1) == "inherit"))

  reckon parse_ui_property(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, allow_inherit : Truth) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_ui_state_after_type(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_ui_state(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =

      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "property",
        parse_ui_theme_after_property(tokens, name, parse_ui_property(tokens, index, true), declarations),
        syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_UI_THEME_CLAUSE")))

  reckon parse_ui_theme(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_THEME_NAME"),
      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 2, "{", "RCL_UI_THEME_OPEN"),
        parse_ui_theme_body(tokens, index + 3, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), empty_sequence()), empty_sequence()), empty_sequence())

  reckon make_ui_style(name : Text, selector_kind : Text, selector_value : Text, priority : Number, declarations : Sequence, order : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), selector_kind), selector_value), priority), declarations), order)

  reckon parse_ui_style_after_property(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, selector_kind : Text, selector_value : Text, priority : Number, declarations : Sequence, order : Number, property_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_ui_style_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text, selector_kind : Text, selector_value : Text, priority : Number, declarations : Sequence, order : Number) -> Sequence =

        make_node_state(index + 1, make_ui_style(name, selector_kind, selector_value, priority, declarations, order)), empty_sequence()),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "target",
        parse_ui_style_body(tokens, index + 3, name, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 2), 1), priority, declarations, order),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "priority",
          parse_ui_style_body(tokens, index + 2, name, selector_kind, selector_value,
            number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)), declarations, order),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "property",
            parse_ui_style_after_property(tokens, name, selector_kind, selector_value, priority, declarations, order,
              parse_ui_property(tokens, index, true)),
            syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_UI_STYLE_CLAUSE")))))

  reckon parse_ui_style(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, order : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_STYLE_NAME"),
      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 2, "{", "RCL_UI_STYLE_OPEN"),

  reckon make_ui_layout(mode : Text, width_mode : Text, width_value : Text, height_mode : Text, height_value : Text, gap : Number, padding : Number, alignment : Text, distribution : Text, overflow : Text, columns : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon default_ui_layout() -> Sequence = make_ui_layout("vertical", "fill", "", "intrinsic", "", 0, 0, "stretch", "start", "visible", 1)

  reckon ui_layout_extensions_with_base(node : Sequence, base : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon ui_layout_with_width(node : Sequence, mode : Text, value : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_ui_layout_size(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, axis : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_WIDTH_MODE"),
      choose(semantic_check(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "fill"
          or sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "intrinsic" or sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "fixed",
          "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_SIZE_MODE", axis + ":" + sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "fixed",
          choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 2, "NUMBER", "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_FIXED_SIZE"),
            choose(semantic_check(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 2), 1)) >= 0,
                "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_FIXED_SIZE", axis),
              parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 3,
                choose(axis == "width",
                  ui_layout_with_width(node, "fixed", text(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 2), 1)))),
                  ui_layout_with_height(node, "fixed", text(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 2), 1)))))),
              empty_sequence()), empty_sequence()),
          parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
            choose(axis == "width",
              ui_layout_with_width(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), ""),
              ui_layout_with_height(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), "")))),
        empty_sequence()), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_ui_layout_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "width",
        parse_ui_layout_size(tokens, index, node, "width"),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "height",
          parse_ui_layout_size(tokens, index, node, "height"),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "gap",
            parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
              make_ui_layout(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9), sequence_get(node, 10))),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "padding",
              parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
                make_ui_layout(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9), sequence_get(node, 10))),
              choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "align",
                parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
                  make_ui_layout(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9), sequence_get(node, 10))),
                choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "distribute",
                  parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
                    make_ui_layout(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), sequence_get(node, 9), sequence_get(node, 10))),
                  choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "overflow",
                    parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
                      make_ui_layout(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), sequence_get(node, 10))),
                    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "columns",
                      parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 2,
                        make_ui_layout(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9), number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)))),
                      syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_CLAUSE"))))))))))

  reckon parse_ui_layout(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_MODE"),
      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 2, "{", "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_OPEN"),
        parse_ui_layout_body(tokens, index + 3,
          make_ui_layout(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), "fill", "", "intrinsic", "", 0, 0, "stretch", "start", "visible", 1)),
        empty_sequence()), empty_sequence())

  reckon make_ui_parameter(name : Text, value_type : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), value_type)

  reckon find_ui_parameter_type(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), "",
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == name, sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1),
        find_ui_parameter_type(items, index + 1, name)))

  reckon ui_event_type_allowed(event_type : Text) -> Truth =
    event_type == "activate" or event_type == "input" or event_type == "change" or event_type == "submit"
      or event_type == "focus" or event_type == "blur" or event_type == "navigate" or event_type == "create"
      or event_type == "resume" or event_type == "suspend" or event_type == "destroy" or event_type == "custom"

  reckon ui_expected_event_parameter_type(event_type : Text, name : Text) -> Text =
    choose((event_type == "input" or event_type == "change") and name == "value", "Text",
      choose(event_type == "navigate" and name == "destination", "Text", ""))

  reckon ui_parameter_value_type(event_type : Text, name : Text, declared_type : Text) -> Text =
    choose(declared_type != "", declared_type, ui_expected_event_parameter_type(event_type, name))

  reckon ui_parameter_type_allowed(value_type : Text) -> Truth =
    value_type == "Number" or value_type == "Text" or value_type == "Truth"

  reckon make_ui_event(event_type : Text, parameters : Sequence, statements : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), event_type), parameters), statements)

  reckon make_ui_set(target : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "set-state"), target), expression)
  reckon ui_statements_have_kind(items : Sequence, index : Number, kind : Text) -> Truth =
    choose(index >= length(items), false,
      sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == kind or ui_statements_have_kind(items, index + 1, kind))

  reckon finish_ui_event(index : Number, event_type : Text, parameters : Sequence, statements : Sequence) -> Sequence =
      choose(semantic_check(not ((ui_statements_have_kind(statements, 0, "set-state")
          or ui_statements_have_kind(statements, 0, "navigate"))
        and ui_statements_have_kind(statements, 0, "realize-reality")),
        "RCL_UI_EVENT_MIXED_AUTHORITY", event_type),
      make_node_state(index, make_ui_event(event_type, parameters, statements)), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_ui_event_after_expression(tokens : Sequence, event_type : Text, parameters : Sequence, target : Text, statements : Sequence, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_ui_event_body(tokens, sequence_get(expression_state, 0), event_type, parameters,
      sequence_append(statements, make_ui_set(target, sequence_get(expression_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_ui_event_after_target(tokens : Sequence, event_type : Text, parameters : Sequence, statements : Sequence, target_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_token(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0), "<-", "RCL_UI_EVENT_ASSIGN"),
      parse_ui_event_after_expression(tokens, event_type, parameters, sequence_get(target_state, 1), statements,
        parse_expression(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0) + 1, 0)), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_ui_event_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, event_type : Text, parameters : Sequence, statements : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", finish_ui_event(index + 1, event_type, parameters, statements),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "set",
        parse_ui_event_after_target(tokens, event_type, parameters, statements, parse_path(tokens, index + 1)),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "realize",
          choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_REALITY_RULE"),
            parse_ui_event_body(tokens, index + 2, event_type, parameters,
              sequence_append(statements,

                      syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_UI_DECLARATION"))))))))))

  reckon pui(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_NAME"),
      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 2, "{", "RCL_UI_OPEN"),
        parse_ui_body(tokens, index + 3, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), default_ui_extensions(), empty_sequence()),

  reckon make_extras() -> Sequence =

  reckon replace_extra(items : Sequence, target : Number, value : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      replace_extra(items, target, value, index + 1,
        sequence_append(output, choose(index == target, value, sequence_get(items, index)))))

  reckon append_extra(items : Sequence, target : Number, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    replace_extra(items, target, sequence_append(sequence_get(items, target), value), 0, empty_sequence())

  reckon make_absorption(kind : Text, target : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon make_program(name : Text, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, subjects : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, rules : Sequence, directives : Sequence, extras : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), facets), reckons), subjects), warrants), rules), directives), extras)

  reckon program_dialects(program : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(sequence_get(program, 7), 1)
  reckon program_effects(program : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_get(sequence_get(program, 7), 2)

  reckon parse_top(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, subjects : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, rules : Sequence, directives : Sequence, extras : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == "EOF", syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_REALITY_UNCLOSED"),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}",
        make_node_state(index + 1, make_program(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  1), 1), facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives, extras)),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "facet" or sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "input",
        parse_top_after_facet(tokens, parse_facet(tokens, index), facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives, extras),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "reckon",
          parse_top_after_reckon(tokens, parse_reckon(tokens, index), facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives, extras),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "subject",
            parse_top_after_subject(tokens, parse_subject(tokens, index), facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives, extras),
            choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "emergence", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "resonance"),
              parse_top_after_rule(tokens, parse_rule(tokens, index), facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives, extras),
              choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "foresee", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "realize"),
                parse_top(tokens, index + 2, facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules,
                  sequence_append(directives,
                    make_directive(choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "foresee", "Foresee", "Realize"), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))), extras),
                parse_metadata_top(tokens, index, facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives, extras))))))))

  reckon parse_top_after_facet(tokens : Sequence, item_state : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, subjects : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, rules : Sequence, directives : Sequence, extras : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_top_after_reckon(tokens : Sequence, item_state : Sequence, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, subjects : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, rules : Sequence, directives : Sequence, extras : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_top_after_extra(tokens : Sequence, item_state : Sequence, target : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, subjects : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, rules : Sequence, directives : Sequence, extras : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_metadata_top(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, facets : Sequence, reckons : Sequence, subjects : Sequence, warrants : Sequence, rules : Sequence, directives : Sequence, extras : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "host",

      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "dialect",

            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "store",

              choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "ui",

                choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "verify", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "snapshot"),
                  parse_top(tokens, index + 2, facets, reckons, subjects, warrants, rules, directives,
                    append_extra(extras, 5,
                      make_absorption(choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "verify", "VerifyCapabilities", "SnapshotStore"),
                        sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)))),
                  syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_UNKNOWN_TOP_LEVEL"))))))))

  reckon parse_program_after_top(tokens : Sequence, parse_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, sequence_get(parse_state, 0), "EOF", "RCL_TRAILING_CONTENT"),
