reality RCLGeneralSelfHostCompiler {
  facet selfhost.splice_format : Text = "rcl-open-module-v1: concatenate compiler-core.rcl, newline, compiler-main.rcl"

  reckon make_token_node(kind : Text, value : Text, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), kind), value), line), column)

  reckon token_span_at(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Span =
    make_span(0, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 2), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 3), 0)

  reckon require_token(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expected : Text, code : Text) -> Truth =
    semantic_assert(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == expected, code, expected, token_span_at(tokens, index))

  reckon require_kind(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expected : Text, code : Text) -> Truth =
    semantic_assert(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == expected, code, expected, token_span_at(tokens, index))

  reckon syntax_failure(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, code : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(semantic_assert(false, code, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1), token_span_at(tokens, index)),
      make_node_state(index, empty_sequence()), make_node_state(index, empty_sequence()))

  reckon make_text_state(index : Number, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), value)

  reckon make_node_state(index : Number, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), value)

  reckon append_all(items : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence = sequence_concat(output, items)

  reckon find_text(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(items, index) == value, index, find_text(items, index + 1, value)))

  reckon find_number(items : Sequence, index : Number, value : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(items), -1,
      choose(sequence_get(items, index) == value, index, find_number(items, index + 1, value)))

  reckon append_unique_number(items : Sequence, value : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(find_number(items, 0, value) >= 0, items, sequence_append(items, value))

  reckon either(left : Truth, right : Truth) -> Truth = choose(left, true, right)
  reckon both(left : Truth, right : Truth) -> Truth = choose(left, right, false)
  reckon minus_operator() -> Text = char_at("-x", 0)
  reckon not_operator() -> Text = slice_text("notx", 0, 3)

  reckon scan_identifier_end(source : Text, index : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(is_identifier_part(char_at(source, index)), scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1), index))

  reckon scan_number_end(source : Text, index : Number, seen_dot : Truth) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(is_digit(char_at(source, index)), scan_number_end(source, index + 1, seen_dot),
        choose(both(char_at(source, index) == char_at(".", 0), not seen_dot),
          scan_number_end(source, index + 1, true), index)))

  reckon scan_string_end(source : Text, index : Number, escaped : Truth) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(escaped, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false),
        choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\\", 0), scan_string_end(source, index + 1, true),
          choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\"", 0), index,
            scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false)))))

  reckon decoded_escape(value : Text) -> Text =
    choose(value == "n", "\n",
      choose(value == "r", "\r",
        choose(value == "t", "\t",
          choose(value == "\"", "\"", choose(value == "\\", "\\", value)))))

  reckon decode_string_from(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= end, output,
      choose(char_at(source, index) == char_at("\\", 0),
        decode_string_from(source, index + 2, end, output + decoded_escape(char_at(source, index + 1))),
        decode_string_from(source, index + 1, end, output + char_at(source, index))))

  reckon scan_comment_end(source : Text, index : Number) -> Number =
    choose(index >= length(source), index,
      choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n", index, scan_comment_end(source, index + 1)))

  reckon position_after(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= end, sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), line), column),
      choose(char_at(source, index) == "\n",
        position_after(source, index + 1, end, line + 1, 1),
        position_after(source, index + 1, end, line, column + choose(length(utf8_bytes(char_at(source, index))) == 4, 2, 1))))

  reckon is_two_symbol(value : Text) -> Truth =
    value == "<-" or value == "->" or value == "==" or value == "!=" or value == "<=" or value == ">="

  reckon concat_token_chunks(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), output,
      concat_token_chunks(items, index + 1, sequence_concat(output, sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon tokenize_emit(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence, token : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(chunk) >= 127,
      tokenize_from(source, index, line, column, sequence_append(chunks, chunk),
        sequence_append(empty_sequence(), token)),
      tokenize_from(source, index, line, column, chunks, sequence_append(chunk, token)))


  reckon indexed_identifier_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_emit(source, end, line, column + end - index, chunks, chunk,
      make_token_node("IDENT", slice_text(source, index, end - index), line, column))
  reckon indexed_number_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_emit(source, end, line, column + end - index, chunks, chunk,
      make_token_node("NUMBER", slice_text(source, index, end - index), line, column))
  reckon indexed_comment_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_from(source, end, line, column + end - index, chunks, chunk)
  reckon indexed_string_position_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, position : Sequence, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    tokenize_emit(source, end + 1, sequence_get(position, 0), sequence_get(position, 1), chunks, chunk,
      make_token_node("STRING", decode_string_from(source, index + 1, end, ""), line, column))
  reckon indexed_string_emit(source : Text, index : Number, end : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_string_position_emit(source, index, end, line, column, position_after(source, index, end + 1, line, column), chunks, chunk)

  reckon tokenize_from(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(source),
      concat_token_chunks(sequence_append(chunks, sequence_append(chunk, make_token_node("EOF", "<eof>", line, column))), 0, empty_sequence()),
      indexed_tokenize_character(source, index, line, column, chunks, chunk, char_at(source, index)))

  reckon indexed_tokenize_character(source : Text, index : Number, line : Number, column : Number, chunks : Sequence, chunk : Sequence, character : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(is_whitespace(character),
        choose(character == "\n",
          tokenize_from(source, index + 1, line + 1, 1, chunks, chunk),
          tokenize_from(source, index + 1, line, column + 1, chunks, chunk)),
        choose(either(character == char_at("#", 0), slice_text(source, index, 2) == "//"),
          indexed_comment_emit(source, index, scan_comment_end(source, index), line, column, chunks, chunk),
          choose(is_identifier_start(character),
            indexed_identifier_emit(source, index, scan_identifier_end(source, index + 1), line, column, chunks, chunk),
            choose(is_digit(character),
              indexed_number_emit(source, index, scan_number_end(source, index + 1, false), line, column, chunks, chunk),
              choose(character == char_at("\"", 0),
                indexed_string_emit(source, index, scan_string_end(source, index + 1, false), line, column, chunks, chunk),
                choose(is_two_symbol(slice_text(source, index, 2)),
                  tokenize_emit(source, index + 2, line, column + 2, chunks, chunk,
                    make_token_node("SYMBOL", slice_text(source, index, 2), line, column)),
                  tokenize_emit(source, index + 1, line, column + 1, chunks, chunk,
                    make_token_node("SYMBOL", character, line, column))))))))

  reckon tokenize(source : Text) -> Sequence = tokenize_from(source, 0, 1, 1, empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_path_tail(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == ".",
      parse_path_tail(tokens, index + 2, value + "." + sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)),
      make_text_state(index, value))

  reckon parse_path(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_path_tail(tokens, index + 1, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))

  reckon literal_node(value_type : Text, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "LiteralExpr"), value_type), value))

  reckon path_node(path : Text) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "PathExpr"), path))

  reckon unary_node(operator : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "UnaryExpr"), operator), expression))

  reckon binary_node(operator : Text, left : Sequence, right : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "BinaryExpr"), operator), left), right))

  reckon call_node(name : Text, args : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    indexed_counted_node(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "CallExpr"), name), args))

  reckon binary_precedence(operator : Text) -> Number =
    choose(operator == "or", 1,
      choose(operator == "and", 2,
        choose(operator == "==" or operator == "!=", 3,
          choose(operator == "<" or operator == "<=" or operator == ">" or operator == ">=", 4,
            choose(operator == "+" or operator == minus_operator(), 5,
              choose(operator == "*" or operator == "/" or operator == "%", 6, 0))))))

  reckon parse_call_args(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == ")", make_node_state(index + 1, output),
      parse_call_args_after(tokens, parse_expression(tokens, index, 0), output))

  reckon parse_call_args_after(tokens : Sequence, item_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(item_state, 0)), 1) == ",",
      parse_call_args(tokens, sequence_get(item_state, 0) + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(item_state, 1))),
      make_node_state(sequence_get(item_state, 0) + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(item_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_prefix(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == not_operator(), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == minus_operator()),
      parse_unary_after(tokens, index, parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 7)),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == "NUMBER",
        make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Number", text(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))))),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 0) == "STRING",
          make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Text", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))),
          choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "true", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "false"),
            make_node_state(index + 1, literal_node("Truth", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1))),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "(",
              parse_parenthesized_after(parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 0)),
              parse_identifier_expression(tokens, parse_path(tokens, index)))))))

  reckon parse_unary_after(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0), unary_node(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1), sequence_get(expression_state, 1)))

  reckon parse_parenthesized_after(expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0) + 1, sequence_get(expression_state, 1))

  reckon parse_identifier_expression(tokens : Sequence, path_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(path_state, 0)), 1) == "(",
      parse_identifier_call_after(sequence_get(path_state, 1), parse_call_args(tokens, sequence_get(path_state, 0) + 1, empty_sequence())),
      make_node_state(sequence_get(path_state, 0), path_node(sequence_get(path_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_identifier_call_after(name : Text, args_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(args_state, 0), call_node(name, sequence_get(args_state, 1)))

  reckon parse_binary_tail(tokens : Sequence, left : Sequence, index : Number, minimum : Number) -> Sequence =
    indexed_parse_binary_tail(tokens, left, index, minimum, binary_precedence(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1)))

  reckon indexed_parse_binary_tail(tokens : Sequence, left : Sequence, index : Number, minimum : Number, precedence : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(precedence < minimum or precedence == 0,
      make_node_state(index, left),
      parse_binary_right(tokens, left, index, minimum,
        parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, precedence + 1)))


  reckon parse_binary_right(tokens : Sequence, left : Sequence, operator_index : Number, minimum : Number, right_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_binary_tail(tokens,
      binary_node(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  operator_index), 1), left, sequence_get(right_state, 1)),
      sequence_get(right_state, 0), minimum)

  reckon parse_expression(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, minimum : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_expression_after_prefix(tokens, minimum, parse_prefix(tokens, index))

  reckon parse_expression_after_prefix(tokens : Sequence, minimum : Number, prefix_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_binary_tail(tokens, sequence_get(prefix_state, 1), sequence_get(prefix_state, 0), minimum)

  reckon make_param(name : Text, value_type : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), value_type)

  reckon parse_params(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == ")", make_node_state(index + 1, output),
      parse_param_type(tokens, index, parse_path(tokens, index + 2), output))

  reckon parse_param_type(tokens : Sequence, name_index : Number, type_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(type_state, 0)), 1) == ",",
      parse_params(tokens, sequence_get(type_state, 0) + 1,
        sequence_append(output, make_param(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  name_index), 1), sequence_get(type_state, 1)))),
      make_node_state(sequence_get(type_state, 0) + 1,
        sequence_append(output, make_param(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  name_index), 1), sequence_get(type_state, 1)))))

  reckon make_facet(path : Text, value_type : Text, expression : Sequence, owner : Text, line : Number, column : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), path), value_type), expression), owner), line), column)

  reckon facet_input(node : Sequence) -> Truth = choose(length(node) > 6, sequence_get(node, 6), false)
  reckon mark_input(node : Sequence, input : Truth) -> Sequence = choose(input, sequence_append(node, true), node)

  reckon make_reckon(name : Text, params : Sequence, return_type : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(
      sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), params), return_type), expression),
      expression_count(expression))

  reckon parse_facet_after_path(tokens : Sequence, start : Number, path_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_facet_after_type(tokens, start, sequence_get(path_state, 1), parse_path(tokens, sequence_get(path_state, 0) + 1))

  reckon parse_facet_after_type(tokens : Sequence, start : Number, path : Text, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_facet_after_expression(tokens, start, path, sequence_get(type_state, 1),
      parse_expression(tokens, sequence_get(type_state, 0) + 1, 0))

  reckon parse_facet_after_expression(tokens : Sequence, start : Number, path : Text, value_type : Text, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0),
      mark_input(make_facet(path, value_type, sequence_get(expression_state, 1), "", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  start), 2), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  start), 3)), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  start), 1) == "input"))

  reckon parse_facet(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_facet_after_path(tokens, index, parse_path(tokens, index + 1))

  reckon parse_reckon_after_params(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, params_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_reckon_after_type(tokens, name, sequence_get(params_state, 1), parse_path(tokens, sequence_get(params_state, 0) + 1))

  reckon parse_reckon_after_type(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, params : Sequence, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_reckon_after_expression(name, params, sequence_get(type_state, 1),
      parse_expression(tokens, sequence_get(type_state, 0) + 1, 0))

  reckon parse_reckon_after_expression(name : Text, params : Sequence, return_type : Text, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0), make_reckon(name, params, return_type, sequence_get(expression_state, 1)))

  reckon parse_reckon(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_reckon_after_params(tokens, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), parse_params(tokens, index + 3, empty_sequence()))

  reckon own_facet(node : Sequence, owner : Text) -> Sequence =
    mark_input(make_facet(owner + "." + sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), owner, sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5)), facet_input(node))

  reckon parse_owned_facet_after(owner : Text, item_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(item_state, 0), own_facet(sequence_get(item_state, 1), owner))

  reckon parse_owned_facet(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, owner : Text) -> Sequence =
    parse_owned_facet_after(owner, parse_facet(tokens, index))

  reckon make_warrant(subject : Text, capability : Text, target : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), subject), capability), target)

  reckon warrant_conditional(node : Sequence) -> Truth = length(node) > 3
  reckon parse_warrant_condition(subject : Text, capability : Text, target : Text, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_node_state(sequence_get(expression_state, 0), sequence_append(make_warrant(subject, capability, target), sequence_get(expression_state, 1)))

  reckon parse_warrant_after_target(tokens : Sequence, subject : Text, capability : Text, target_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(target_state, 0)), 1) == "while",
      parse_warrant_condition(subject, capability, sequence_get(target_state, 1), parse_expression(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0) + 1, 0)),
      make_node_state(sequence_get(target_state, 0), make_warrant(subject, capability, sequence_get(target_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_warrant_after_capability(tokens : Sequence, subject : Text, capability_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_warrant_after_target(tokens, subject, sequence_get(capability_state, 1), parse_path(tokens, sequence_get(capability_state, 0) + 1))

  reckon parse_warrant(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, subject : Text) -> Sequence =
    parse_warrant_after_capability(tokens, subject, parse_path(tokens, index + 1))

  reckon make_subject_state(index : Number, name : Text, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), index), name), facets), warrants)

  reckon parse_subject_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_subject_state(index + 1, name, facets, warrants),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "facet" or sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "input",
        parse_subject_after_facet(tokens, name, parse_owned_facet(tokens, index, name), facets, warrants),
        parse_subject_after_warrant(tokens, name, parse_warrant(tokens, index, name), facets, warrants)))

  reckon parse_subject_after_facet(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, item_state : Sequence, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_subject_body(tokens, sequence_get(item_state, 0), name, sequence_append(facets, sequence_get(item_state, 1)), warrants)

  reckon parse_subject_after_warrant(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, item_state : Sequence, facets : Sequence, warrants : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_subject_body(tokens, sequence_get(item_state, 0), name, facets, sequence_append(warrants, sequence_get(item_state, 1)))

  reckon parse_subject(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_subject_body(tokens, index + 3, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())

  reckon make_need(capability : Text, target : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), capability), target)

  reckon make_alter(target : Text, expression : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), target), expression)

  reckon make_rule(kind : Text, name : Text, cause : Text, from_subject : Text, into_subject : Text, when_expression : Sequence, needs : Sequence, preserves : Sequence, alters : Sequence, witnesses : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), kind), name), cause), from_subject), into_subject), when_expression), needs), preserves), alters), witnesses)

  reckon rule_with_cause(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), value, sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_from(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), value, sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_into(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), value, sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_when(node : Sequence, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), value, sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_need(node : Sequence, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 6), value), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_preserve(node : Sequence, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 7), value), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_alter(node : Sequence, value : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 8), value), sequence_get(node, 9))

  reckon rule_with_witness(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =
    make_rule(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(node, 8), sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 9), value))

  reckon parse_rule_after_expression(tokens : Sequence, expression_state : Sequence, node : Sequence, clause : Text) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_body(tokens, sequence_get(expression_state, 0),
      choose(clause == "when", rule_with_when(node, sequence_get(expression_state, 1)),
        rule_with_preserve(node, sequence_get(expression_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_rule_after_need_target(tokens : Sequence, capability : Text, target_state : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_body(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0), rule_with_need(node, make_need(capability, sequence_get(target_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_rule_after_need_capability(tokens : Sequence, capability_state : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_after_need_target(tokens, sequence_get(capability_state, 1), parse_path(tokens, sequence_get(capability_state, 0) + 1), node)

  reckon parse_rule_after_alter_expression(tokens : Sequence, target : Text, node : Sequence, expression_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_body(tokens, sequence_get(expression_state, 0), rule_with_alter(node, make_alter(target, sequence_get(expression_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_rule_after_alter_target(tokens : Sequence, target_state : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_after_alter_expression(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 1), node,
      parse_expression(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0) + 1, 0))

  reckon parse_rule_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "cause",
        parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2, rule_with_cause(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "from",
          parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2, rule_with_from(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "into",
            parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2, rule_with_into(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
            choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "when", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "preserve"),
              parse_rule_after_expression(tokens, parse_expression(tokens, index + 1, 0), node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1)),
              choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "needs",
                parse_rule_after_need_capability(tokens, parse_path(tokens, index + 1), node),
                choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "alter",
                  parse_rule_after_alter_target(tokens, parse_path(tokens, index + 1), node),
                  parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 2,
                    rule_with_witness(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))))))))))

  reckon parse_rule(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_rule_body(tokens, index + 3,
      make_rule(choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "emergence", "Emergence", "Resonance"),
        sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), "", "", "", empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence()))

  reckon make_directive(kind : Text, name : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), kind), name)

  reckon parse_name_list_after_path(tokens : Sequence, path_state : Sequence, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(path_state, 0)), 1) == ",",
      parse_name_list(tokens, sequence_get(path_state, 0) + 1, sequence_append(output, sequence_get(path_state, 1))),
      make_node_state(sequence_get(path_state, 0), sequence_append(output, sequence_get(path_state, 1))))

  reckon parse_name_list(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, output : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_name_list_after_path(tokens, parse_path(tokens, index), output)

  reckon make_offer(capability : Text, return_type : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), capability), return_type)

  reckon parse_effect_after_lowers(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_effect_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =

      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "deterministic",
        parse_effect_body(tokens, index + 2, effect_with_deterministic(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),

          parse_effect_body(tokens, index + 2, effect_with_replay(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "evidence_required",
            parse_effect_body(tokens, index + 2, effect_with_evidence(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "description",
              parse_effect_body(tokens, index + 2, effect_with_description(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
              parse_effect_after_lowers(tokens, node, parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())))))))

  reckon parse_effect(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_effect_body(tokens, index + 3,
      make_effect(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), "true", "deterministic", "false", "", empty_sequence()))

  reckon make_store(name : Text, branches : Sequence, commits : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_store_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "branch",
        parse_store_body(tokens, index + 2,
          make_store(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)), sequence_get(node, 2))),
        parse_store_body(tokens, index + 2,

  reckon parse_store(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon make_dialect_operation(name : Text, inputs : Sequence, outputs : Sequence, effects : Sequence, lowers_to : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), inputs), outputs), effects), lowers_to)

  reckon parse_operation_after_type(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, clause : Text, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_dialect_operation_body(tokens, sequence_get(type_state, 0),
      choose(clause == "input",
        make_dialect_operation(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(type_state, 1)),
          sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4)),
        make_dialect_operation(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1),
          sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(type_state, 1)), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4))))

  reckon parse_operation_after_list(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, clause : Text, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

        make_dialect_operation(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
          append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 4))),
        make_dialect_operation(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2),
          append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 3)), sequence_get(node, 4))))

  reckon parse_dialect_operation_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "input", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "output"),
        parse_operation_after_type(tokens, node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1), parse_path(tokens, index + 1)),
        parse_operation_after_list(tokens, node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1),
          parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence()))))

  reckon make_dialect(id : Text, version : Text, layer : Text, domain : Text, description : Text, operations : Sequence, lowers_to : Sequence, invariants : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon dialect_with_version(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon dialect_with_description(node : Sequence, value : Text) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_dialect_after_domain(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, path_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_dialect_after_lowers(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_dialect_body(tokens, sequence_get(list_state, 0),
      make_dialect(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4),
        sequence_get(node, 5), append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 6)), sequence_get(node, 7)))

  reckon parse_dialect_after_operation(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, operation_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_dialect_body(tokens, sequence_get(operation_state, 0),
      make_dialect(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4),
        sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(operation_state, 1)), sequence_get(node, 6), sequence_get(node, 7)))

  reckon parse_dialect_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "version",
        parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2, dialect_with_version(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "layer",
          parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2, dialect_with_layer(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "domain",
            parse_dialect_after_domain(tokens, node, parse_path(tokens, index + 1)),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "description",
              parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2, dialect_with_description(node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
              choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "lowers_to",
                parse_dialect_after_lowers(tokens, node, parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())),
                choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "operation",
                  parse_dialect_after_operation(tokens, node, parse_dialect_operation(tokens, index)),
                  parse_dialect_body(tokens, index + 2,
                    make_dialect(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4),
                      sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6),
                      sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 7), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)))))))))))

  reckon parse_dialect(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon make_policy(name : Text, allowed : Sequence, denied : Sequence, capabilities : Sequence, host_capabilities : Sequence, budget : Sequence, require_replay : Text) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), name), allowed), denied), capabilities), host_capabilities), budget), require_replay)

  reckon parse_policy_after_list(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, clause : Text, list_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_body(tokens, sequence_get(list_state, 0),
      choose(clause == "allow_effect",
        make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 1)), sequence_get(node, 2),
          sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)),
        choose(clause == "deny_effect",
          make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 2)),
            sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)),
          make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
            append_all(sequence_get(list_state, 1), sequence_get(node, 4)), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)))))

  reckon parse_policy_after_target(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, capability : Text, target_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_body(tokens, sequence_get(target_state, 0),
      make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2),

        sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)))

  reckon parse_policy_after_capability(tokens : Sequence, node : Sequence, capability_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_after_target(tokens, node, sequence_get(capability_state, 1), parse_path(tokens, sequence_get(capability_state, 0) + 1))

  reckon parse_policy_require(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "true", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "false"),
      parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 2,
        make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
          sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1))),
      parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 1,
        make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
          sequence_get(node, 4), sequence_get(node, 5), "true")))

  reckon parse_policy_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "}", make_node_state(index + 1, node),
      choose(either(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "allow_effect", sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "deny_effect"),
        parse_policy_after_list(tokens, node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1),
          parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "allow",
          parse_policy_after_capability(tokens, node, parse_path(tokens, index + 1)),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "allow_host",
            parse_policy_after_list(tokens, node, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1),
              parse_name_list(tokens, index + 1, empty_sequence())),
            choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "budget",
              parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 3,
                make_policy(sequence_get(node, 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 3),
                  sequence_get(node, 4),
                  sequence_append(sequence_get(node, 5), make_budget(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1),
                    text(number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 2), 1))))), sequence_get(node, 6))),
              parse_policy_require(tokens, index, node))))))

  reckon parse_policy(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    parse_policy_body(tokens, index + 3,
      make_policy(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), "false"))

      make_ui_property(name, sequence_get(expression_state, 1), allow_inherit and sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  sequence_get(expression_state, 0)), 1) == "inherit"))

  reckon parse_ui_property(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, allow_inherit : Truth) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_PROPERTY_NAME"),
      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 2, "=", "RCL_UI_PROPERTY_ASSIGN"),
        parse_ui_property_after_expression(tokens, parse_expression(tokens, index + 3, 0), sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), allow_inherit),

  reckon parse_ui_state_after_type(tokens : Sequence, name : Text, type_state : Sequence) -> Sequence =

  reckon parse_ui_state(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_STATE_NAME"),
      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 2, ":", "RCL_UI_STATE_TYPE"),
        parse_ui_state_after_type(tokens, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), parse_path(tokens, index + 3)),
        empty_sequence()), empty_sequence())

  reckon parse_ui_theme_body(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text, declarations : Sequence) -> Sequence =

      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "property",
        parse_ui_theme_after_property(tokens, name, parse_ui_property(tokens, index, true), declarations),

  reckon parse_ui_theme(tokens : Sequence, index : Number) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_THEME_NAME"),

        parse_ui_theme_body(tokens, index + 3, sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1), empty_sequence()), empty_sequence()), empty_sequence())

        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "priority",

            number_from_text(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1)), declarations, order),
          choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "property",
            parse_ui_style_after_property(tokens, name, selector_kind, selector_value, priority, declarations, order,

            syntax_failure(tokens, index, "RCL_UI_STYLE_CLAUSE")))))

  reckon parse_ui_style(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, order : Number) -> Sequence =

  reckon default_ui_layout() -> Sequence = make_ui_layout("vertical", "fill", "", "intrinsic", "", 0, 0, "stretch", "start", "visible", 1)

  reckon parse_ui_layout_size(tokens : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, axis : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(require_kind(tokens, index + 1, "IDENT", "RCL_UI_LAYOUT_WIDTH_MODE"),
      choose(semantic_check(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index + 1), 1) == "fill"

          restore, themes, styles, navigation, views)), empty_sequence()),

        parse_ui_body_after_state(tokens, name, states, derived, stages, restore, themes, styles, navigation, views, false,
          parse_ui_state(tokens, index)),
        choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "derived",
          parse_ui_body_after_state(tokens, name, states, derived, stages, restore, themes, styles, navigation, views, true,
            parse_ui_state(tokens, index)),

            parse_ui_body_after_theme(tokens, name, states, derived, stages, restore, themes, styles, navigation, views,

                  choose(semantic_check(length(sequence_get(navigation, 0)) == 0, "RCL_UI_NAVIGATION_DUPLICATE", name),
                    choose(require_token(tokens, index + 1, "{", "RCL_UI_NAVIGATION_OPEN"),
                      parse_ui_body_after_structure(tokens, name, states, derived, stages, restore, themes, styles, navigation, views, true,
                        parse_ui_navigation_body(tokens, index + 2, "", empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())), empty_sequence()), empty_sequence()),
                  choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(tokens,  index), 1) == "adaptation",
                    choose(semantic_check(length(sequence_get(navigation, 1)) == 0, "RCL_UI_DEVICE_ADAPTATION_DUPLICATE", name),
                      choose(require_token(tokens, index + 1, "{", "RCL_UI_DEVICE_ADAPTATION_OPEN"),
                        parse_ui_body_after_adaptation(tokens, name, states, derived, stages, restore, themes, styles, navigation, views,
                          parse_ui_adaptation_body(tokens, index + 2, "", empty_sequence(), empty_sequence(), empty_sequence())),
                        empty_sequence()), empty_sequence()),

  reckon quote_character() -> Text = char_at("\"x", 0)
  reckon slash_character() -> Text = char_at("\\x", 0)

  reckon json_escape_character(value : Text) -> Text =
    choose(contains("\"\\\n\r\t", value),
      choose(value == quote_character(), slash_character() + quote_character(),
        choose(value == slash_character(), slash_character() + slash_character(),
          choose(value == "\n", slash_character() + "n", choose(value == "\r", slash_character() + "r", slash_character() + "t")))), value)

  reckon json_escape_from(value : Text, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(value), output,
      json_escape_from(value, index + 1, output + json_escape_character(char_at(value, index))))

  reckon json_quote(value : Text) -> Text =
    quote_character() + choose(contains(value, quote_character()) or contains(value, slash_character())
      or contains(value, "\n") or contains(value, "\r") or contains(value, "\t"),
      json_escape_from(value, 0, ""), value) + quote_character()

  reckon json_truth(value : Text) -> Text = choose(value == "true", "true", "false")

  reckon ui_literal_json(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Text", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)),
      choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Truth", json_truth(sequence_get(node, 2)), sequence_get(node, 2)))

  reckon find_ui_state_type(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Text =

        find_ui_state_type(items, index + 1, name)))

  reckon ui_reference_type(name : Text, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence) -> Text =

      choose(find_ui_state_type(derived, 0, name) != "", find_ui_state_type(derived, 0, name),
        choose(find_ui_parameter_type(parameters, 0, name) != "", find_ui_parameter_type(parameters, 0, name),

  reckon ui_reference_scope(name : Text, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence) -> Text =

  reckon ui_expression_type(node : Sequence, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "LiteralExpr", sequence_get(node, 1),
      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "PathExpr", ui_reference_type(sequence_get(node, 1), states, derived, parameters),
        choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "UnaryExpr", choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == not_operator(), "Truth", "Number"),
          choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "BinaryExpr",
            choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "+",
              choose(ui_expression_type(sequence_get(node, 2), states, derived, parameters) == "Text" or ui_expression_type(sequence_get(node, 3), states, derived, parameters) == "Text", "Text", "Number"),
              choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == minus_operator() or sequence_get(node, 1) == "*" or sequence_get(node, 1) == "/" or sequence_get(node, 1) == "%", "Number", "Truth")),
            choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "choose", ui_expression_type(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 2), 1), states, derived, parameters), "")))))

  reckon canonical_ui_expression_array(items : Sequence, index : Number, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",

  reckon canonical_ui_expression(node : Sequence, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "LiteralExpr",
      "{\"kind\":\"literal\",\"value\":" + ui_literal_json(node) + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "PathExpr",
        "{\"id\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + ",\"kind\":\"reference\",\"scope\":"
          + json_quote(ui_reference_scope(sequence_get(node, 1), states, derived, parameters)) + ",\"valueType\":"
          + json_quote(ui_reference_type(sequence_get(node, 1), states, derived, parameters)) + "}",
        choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "UnaryExpr",
          "{\"expression\":" + canonical_ui_expression(sequence_get(node, 2), states, derived, parameters) + ",\"kind\":\"unary\",\"operator\":"
            + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(ui_expression_type(node, states, derived, parameters)) + "}",
          choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "BinaryExpr",
            "{\"kind\":\"binary\",\"left\":" + canonical_ui_expression(sequence_get(node, 2), states, derived, parameters)
              + ",\"operator\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + ",\"right\":"
              + canonical_ui_expression(sequence_get(node, 3), states, derived, parameters) + ",\"valueType\":"
              + json_quote(ui_expression_type(node, states, derived, parameters)) + "}",
            "{\"args\":" + canonical_ui_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, states, derived, parameters, "[")
              + ",\"kind\":\"choose\",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(ui_expression_type(node, states, derived, parameters)) + "}"))))

  reckon canonical_ui_bindings(items : Sequence, index : Number, node_id : Text, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_bindings(items, index + 1, node_id, states, derived,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "[" + json_quote(node_id + ".binding." + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0))
          + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) + ","
          + canonical_ui_expression(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1), states, derived, empty_sequence()) + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_event_parameters(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_event_parameters(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "{\"id\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0))
          + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + "}"))

  reckon canonical_ui_event_statement(node : Sequence, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "realize-reality",
      "{\"kind\":\"realize-reality\",\"rule\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "navigate",
        "{\"kind\":\"navigate\",\"route\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
        choose(semantic_check(find_ui_state_type(states, 0, sequence_get(node, 1)) != "", "RCL_UI_EVENT_TARGET_UNKNOWN", sequence_get(node, 1)),
          choose(semantic_check(ui_expression_type(sequence_get(node, 2), states, derived, parameters)
              == find_ui_state_type(states, 0, sequence_get(node, 1)), "RCL_UI_EVENT_MUTATION_TYPE", sequence_get(node, 1)),
            "{\"expression\":" + canonical_ui_expression(sequence_get(node, 2), states, derived, parameters)
              + ",\"kind\":\"set-state\",\"target\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}", ""), "")))

  reckon canonical_ui_event_statements(items : Sequence, index : Number, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, parameters : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_event_statements(items, index + 1, states, derived, parameters,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + canonical_ui_event_statement(sequence_get(items, index), states, derived, parameters)))

  reckon canonical_ui_events(items : Sequence, index : Number, node_id : Text, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_events(items, index + 1, node_id, states, derived,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "[" + json_quote(node_id + ".event." + sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) + "." + text(index))
          + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) + ","
          + canonical_ui_event_parameters(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1), 0, "[") + ","
          + json_quote(choose(ui_statements_have_kind(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 2), 0, "realize-reality"),
            "reality-transaction", "ui-local")) + ","
          + canonical_ui_event_statements(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 2), 0, states, derived,
            sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1), "[") + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_size(mode : Text, value : Text) -> Text =
    "[" + json_quote(mode) + "," + choose(mode == "fixed", value, "null") + "]"

  reckon canonical_ui_layout(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + "," + canonical_ui_size(sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2))
      + "," + canonical_ui_size(sequence_get(node, 3), sequence_get(node, 4)) + "," + text(sequence_get(node, 5))
      + "," + text(sequence_get(node, 6)) + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 7)) + ","
      + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 8)) + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 9)) + "," + text(sequence_get(node, 10)) + "]"

  reckon find_ui_property(items : Sequence, index : Number, name : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(items), empty_sequence(),
      choose(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0) == name, sequence_get(items, index),
        find_ui_property(items, index + 1, name)))

  reckon ui_style_property(name : Text) -> Truth =
    name == "foreground" or name == "background" or name == "font_family" or name == "font_size"
      or name == "text_align" or name == "corner_radius" or name == "language"

  reckon ui_inherited_property(name : Text) -> Truth =
    name == "foreground" or name == "font_family" or name == "font_size" or name == "text_align" or name == "language"

  reckon ui_style_specificity(kind : Text) -> Number = choose(kind == "role", 1, choose(kind == "class", 10, 100))

  reckon ui_style_matches(style : Sequence, node : Sequence) -> Truth =
    choose(sequence_get(style, 1) == "role", sequence_get(style, 2) == sequence_get(node, 1),
      choose(sequence_get(style, 1) == "class", find_text(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, sequence_get(style, 2)) >= 0,
        sequence_get(style, 2) == sequence_get(node, 0)))

  reckon make_resolved_property(found : Truth, value : Text, provenance : Text, score : Number) -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), found), value), provenance), score)

  reckon resolve_ui_rules(styles : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, property : Text, best : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(index >= length(styles), best,
      resolve_ui_rules(styles, index + 1, node, property,
        choose(ui_style_matches(sequence_get(styles, index), node)
            and length(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 4), 0, property)) > 0
            and (sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 3) * 10000
              + ui_style_specificity(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 1)) * 100
              + sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 5)) >= sequence_get(best, 3),
          make_resolved_property(true,
            ui_literal_json(sequence_get(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 4), 0, property), 1)),
            "rule:" + sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 0),
            sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 3) * 10000
              + ui_style_specificity(sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 1)) * 100
              + sequence_get(sequence_get(styles, index), 5)), best)))

  reckon resolve_ui_property_after_rule(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, property : Text, rule : Sequence) -> Sequence =
    choose(sequence_get(rule, 0), rule,
      choose(length(themes) > 0 and length(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 1), 0, property)) > 0,
        make_resolved_property(true,
          ui_literal_json(sequence_get(find_ui_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 1), 0, property), 1)),
          "theme:" + sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 0), 0),
        make_resolved_property(false, "", "", -1)))

  reckon resolve_ui_property(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, property : Text) -> Sequence =
    choose(length(find_ui_property(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, property)) > 0 and ui_style_property(property),
      make_resolved_property(true,
        ui_literal_json(sequence_get(find_ui_property(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, property), 1)),
        "node:" + sequence_get(node, 0), 1000000000),
      resolve_ui_property_after_rule(node, themes, property,
        resolve_ui_rules(styles, 0, node, property, make_resolved_property(false, "", "", -1))))

  reckon ui_style_property_names() -> Sequence =
    sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(sequence_append(empty_sequence(), "background"), "corner_radius"), "font_family"), "font_size"), "foreground"), "language"), "text_align")

  reckon canonical_resolved_object(names : Sequence, index : Number, node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, provenance : Truth, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(names), output + "}",
      canonical_resolved_object(names, index + 1, node, themes, styles, provenance,
        choose(sequence_get(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)), 0),
          output + choose(output == "{", "", ",") + json_quote(sequence_get(names, index)) + ":"
            + choose(provenance,
              json_quote(sequence_get(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)), 2)),
              sequence_get(resolve_ui_property(node, themes, styles, sequence_get(names, index)), 1)), output)))

  reckon canonical_ui_resolved_style(node : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + canonical_resolved_object(ui_style_property_names(), 0, node, themes, styles, false, "{")
      + "," + canonical_resolved_object(ui_style_property_names(), 0, node, themes, styles, true, "{") + "]"

  reckon canonical_ui_nodes(items : Sequence, index : Number, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",

          + "," + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_node(node : Sequence, states : Sequence, derived : Sequence, themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence) -> Text =

      + canonical_ui_texts(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_properties(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_bindings(sequence_get(node, 4), 0, sequence_get(node, 0), states, derived, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_events(sequence_get(node, 5), 0, sequence_get(node, 0), states, derived, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_layout(ui_view_layout(node)) + "," + canonical_ui_adaptive_layouts(ui_view_adaptive_layouts(node), 0, "[")
      + "," + canonical_ui_resolved_style(node, themes, styles) + ","
      + canonical_ui_nodes(sequence_get(node, 7), 0, states, derived, themes, styles, "[") + "]"

  reckon canonical_ui_theme_declarations(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_theme_declarations(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "[" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) + ","
          + ui_literal_json(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + ","
          + json_truth(text(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 2) or ui_inherited_property(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)))) + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_themes(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_ui_themes(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index > 0, ",", "") + "[" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) + ","

  reckon canonical_ui_styles(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

          + canonical_ui_theme_declarations(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 4), 0, "[") + "]"))

  reckon canonical_ui_style_sheet(themes : Sequence, styles : Sequence) -> Text =
    "[" + choose(length(themes) > 0, json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(themes, 0), 0)), "null") + ","

  reckon canonical_ui_routes(ids : Sequence, targets : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_ui_adaptation(node : Sequence) -> Text =

        + ",\"format\":\"rcl.native-ui.device-adaptation.v0.1\",\"profiles\":"

  reckon cui(node : Sequence, reality : Text) -> Text =
    "[\"rcl.native-ui.semantic-genome.v0.1\",\"rcl.native-ui.program.v0.1\",\"0.1.0\",\"UIProgram\"," + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0))
      + "," + json_quote(reality) + "," + canonical_ui_states(sequence_get(node, 1), 0, "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_derived(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, sequence_get(node, 1), "[") + ","
      + canonical_ui_node(sequence_get(sequence_get(node, 8), 0), sequence_get(node, 1), sequence_get(node, 2), sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)) + ","
      + canonical_ui_style_sheet(sequence_get(node, 5), sequence_get(node, 6)) + ",["
      + canonical_ui_texts(sequence_get(node, 3), 0, "[") + "," + canonical_ui_texts(sequence_get(node, 4), 0, "[")
      + "],[" + choose(length(ui_navigation(node)) == 0, "null",
        "{\"format\":\"rcl.native-ui.navigation.v0.1\",\"initialRoute\":"
          + json_quote(sequence_get(ui_navigation(node), 0)) + ",\"routes\":"
          + canonical_ui_routes(sequence_get(ui_navigation(node), 1), sequence_get(ui_navigation(node), 2), 0, "[") + "}")
      + ",[]," + canonical_ui_adaptation(ui_adaptation(node)) + "]]"

  reckon cuis(items : Sequence, index : Number, reality : Text, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",

          + ",\"semanticRoot\":" + json_quote(sha256_text(cui(sequence_get(items, index), reality))) + "}"))

  reckon canonical_expression(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "LiteralExpr",
      "{\"kind\":\"LiteralExpr\",\"value\":"
        + choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Text", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)),
            choose(sequence_get(node, 1) == "Truth", json_truth(sequence_get(node, 2)), sequence_get(node, 2)))
        + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
      choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "PathExpr",
        "{\"kind\":\"PathExpr\",\"path\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
        choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "UnaryExpr",
          "{\"expression\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 2)) + ",\"kind\":\"UnaryExpr\",\"operator\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}",
          choose(sequence_get(node, 0) == "BinaryExpr",
            "{\"kind\":\"BinaryExpr\",\"left\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 2))
              + ",\"operator\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + ",\"right\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 3)) + "}",
            "{\"args\":" + canonical_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 2), 0, "[")
              + ",\"kind\":\"CallExpr\",\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}"))))

  reckon canonical_expression_array(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_expression_array(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index == 0, "", ",") + canonical_expression(sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon canonical_params(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_params(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index == 0, "", ",")
          + "{\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0))
          + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + "}"))

  reckon canonical_facet(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    "{" + choose(facet_input(node), "\"input\":true,", "") + "\"kind\":\"FacetDecl\",\"location\":{\"column\":" + text(sequence_get(node, 5))
      + ",\"line\":" + text(sequence_get(node, 4)) + "},\"owner\":"
      + choose(sequence_get(node, 3) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 3)))
      + ",\"path\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + ",\"value\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 2))
      + ",\"valueType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1)) + "}"

  reckon canonical_facets(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",
      canonical_facets(items, index + 1,
        output + choose(index == 0, "", ",") + canonical_facet(sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon canonical_reckon(node : Sequence) -> Text =
    "{\"expression\":" + canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 3)) + ",\"kind\":\"ReckonDecl\",\"name\":"
      + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + ",\"params\":" + canonical_params(sequence_get(node, 1), 0, "[")
      + ",\"returnType\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)) + "}"

  reckon canonical_reckons(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
    choose(index >= length(items), output + "]",

        output + choose(index == 0, "", ",") + canonical_reckon(sequence_get(items, index))))

  reckon canonical_text_array(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

      + ",\"condition\":" + choose(warrant_conditional(node), canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 3)), "null") + ",\"kind\":\"WarrantDecl\",\"subject\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0))
      + ",\"target\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)) + "}"

  reckon canonical_warrants(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

          + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 0)) + ",\"target\":"
          + json_quote(sequence_get(sequence_get(items, index), 1)) + "}"))

  reckon canonical_alters(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_rule(node : Sequence) -> Text =

      + ",\"calls\":[],\"cause\":" + choose(sequence_get(node, 2) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 2)))
      + ",\"from\":" + choose(sequence_get(node, 3) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 3)))
      + ",\"into\":" + choose(sequence_get(node, 4) == "", "null", json_quote(sequence_get(node, 4)))
      + ",\"kind\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 0)) + ",\"name\":" + json_quote(sequence_get(node, 1))
      + ",\"needs\":" + canonical_needs(sequence_get(node, 6), 0, "[")
      + ",\"preserves\":" + canonical_expression_array(sequence_get(node, 7), 0, "[")
      + ",\"when\":" + choose(length(sequence_get(node, 5)) == 0, "null", canonical_expression(sequence_get(node, 5)))
      + ",\"witnesses\":" + canonical_text_array(sequence_get(node, 9), 0, "[") + "}"

  reckon canonical_rules(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_hosts(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =

  reckon canonical_dialects(items : Sequence, index : Number, output : Text) -> Text =
